mapper.sql:
WHERE c.is_public = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0
AND ( c.name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.background LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.appearance LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.personality LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND c.id IN ( SELECT r.character_id FROM character_tag_relation r WHERE r.tag_id IN
#{tagId}
GROUP BY r.character_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.tag_id) = #{tagCount} )
AND c.id IN ( SELECT r.character_id FROM character_tag_relation r INNER JOIN character_tag t ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.name LIKE concat('%', #{tagKeyword}, '%') )
AND uf.follow_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_character ( name, appearance, background, personality, classic_lines, user_id,image, create_time, update_time, is_deleted, is_public ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{appearance}, #{background}, #{personality}, #{classicLines}, #{userId}, #{image}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE app_character SET image = #{imageUrl}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{characterId} AND is_deleted = 0

name = #{name}, appearance = #{appearance}, background = #{background}, personality = #{personality}, classic_lines = #{classicLines}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
